# String literals preserve embedded NUL characters. Expected values come
# from GoogleSQL mutator compliance cases and BigQuery JSON string encodings.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(JSON '{"a":[1,"foo"]}', '$.a', 'abca\x00\x01\x1a\x1f ', append_each_element => FALSE))
=> "{\"a\":[1,\"foo\",\"abca\\u0000\\u0001\\u001a\\u001f \"]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY_INSERT(JSON '{"a":[1,"foo"]}', '$.a[1]', 'abca\x00\x01\x1a\x1f ', insert_each_element => FALSE))
=> "{\"a\":[1,\"abca\\u0000\\u0001\\u001a\\u001f \",\"foo\"]}"

# BigQuery strings retain NUL and Unicode code points.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_CODE_POINTS(x)) FROM UNNEST(["a\x00あ'"]) AS x
=> "[97,0,12354,39]"

SELECT FORMAT(x) FROM UNNEST(['x\x00y']) AS x
=> "x\u0000y"
